'''2015 Texas Mini Worlds''' was a Players Committee match-play major, 23–25 October 2015. [[Brian Fred]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-texas-mini-worlds/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Texas
* '''Dates:''' 23–25 October 2015
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Fred]]
